I am absolutely devastated and heartbroken by the experience I had with this grooming facility. Within 10 minutes of dropping off my dog, I received a phone call telling me that my dog had fainted and was rushed to the animal hospital. By the time I arrived, my dog had already passed away.

The groomer, who was responsible for bathing and drying my dog, admitted that my dog was stressed and shaking from the blow dryer. However, he did nothing to stop the process until my dog defecated from sheer fear and stress. Only then did he pause the dryer to clean up the mess, and by that time, it was too late—my dog had fainted. The cameras clearly show how long it took him to take action and get my dog the help he needed.

What’s even more upsetting is that the groomer should have stopped immediately once he saw my dog shaking and stressed, but he didn’t. Instead, he allowed my dog to reach such a state of fear and distress that it ultimately cost him his life. My dog was a healthy 7-year-old Yorkie, and doctors believe the probable cause of his death was the severe anxiety and stress he endured in this new environment, particularly from the blow dryer. The stress likely caused him to bloat, which could have led to a stroke or heart attack. This was my first time trusting this groomer, and I deeply regret not following my gut feeling, which told me something wasn’t right from the moment I walked in. I should have listened, and now I have to live with the painful loss of my best friend because I didn’t act sooner.

To make matters worse, the receptionist’s customer service was terrible from the moment I walked in. She took a personal call and had me waiting while I was completely ignored, and then, when I received the call about my dog’s condition, the response was cold and lacked any sense of urgency or empathy. To top it all off, not one person from the facility has called to check on me, offer any condolences, or even acknowledge the loss of my dog.

This was a place I entrusted with my dog’s care, and now, not only have I lost my best friend, but I feel like my concerns were ignored at every step. My dog has gone to numerous grooming appointments in the past without issue, but I will never trust this place again. I don’t want anyone else to go through the same heartbreak I did.

I hope, moving forward, although it took the life of my best friend, this grooming facility learns a valuable lesson. I sincerely hope they become more attuned to a dog's emotions and that they prioritize gaining proper knowledge in handling high-stress situations, learning CPR, and how to act swiftly in emergencies. No one should have to suffer like this again.
